name: encounter
summary: Run a fight offline: the initiative order, whose turn it is, and the round.

combatants.description: With start: every actor in the fight, the party's and the GM's monsters.

id.description: The table's name for the actor, unique in the fight.

initiative.description: The derived initiative value, no roll (docs/core/derived.md).

agi.description: AGI after its modifiers, the first tie-break.

lck.description: LCK after its modifiers, the second tie-break.

rolls.description: The d100 roll-off, made when the encounter starts, kept in the step: lowest first, a tie on a roll read by the next (docs/core/derived.md#initiative-ties).

surprise.description: An ambusher, who acts in the surprise round. Default false.

encounter.description: With turn_end: the fight; a session step fills it from the session.

start.description: The actions command's start for this turn: surprise in the surprise round, combat on the actor's first turn of the fight; absent on a later turn.

next.description: The id whose turn comes after the current one.
